note: Majority: not read. Greenland's private-law acts (Danish acts put in force by royal ordinance, and Greenland's own Inatsisartut acts) aren't published on Retsinformation; nalunaarutit.gl (Greenland's law gazette) was reached but its search wasn't made to work, and a web search in Danish found no majority text; null. Work: the order on young people's work in Greenland (Bekendtgørelse nr. 1347 af 15. december 2005 om unges arbejde i Grønland, under Lov nr. 295 af 4. juni 1986 om arbejdsmiljø i Grønland; a field not taken over by Greenland, so Denmark's Ministry of Employment legislates) isn't on Retsinformation (printed Lovtidende only). The Government of Greenland's answer of 21 May 2025 to Inatsisartut question no. 27-2025 (Naalakkersuisoq for Social Affairs, Labour Market, Home Affairs and Environment) states its rules: children under thirteen may not be employed, though on application the police may let children under thirteen take part in cultural and similar activities; young people of thirteen and over still subject to compulsory schooling may do only the lighter work listed in annexes 7 and 8 of the order; those of fifteen to seventeen no longer subject to compulsory schooling may work, with the order's exceptions. So the general age is 15, for those past compulsory schooling (my reading; the school-leaving age isn't held). Performers: permit, the police's permission for a child under thirteen in cultural and similar activities; from thirteen, schoolchildren may do only the annexes' light work, which weren't read, so whether a thirteen- or fourteen-year-old may perform is my open reading. The order's own text wasn't read. Service: Denmark's Værnepligtsloven (consolidated by LBK nr 225 af 13/03/2006, amended to LOV nr 715 af 20/06/2025, which from 2026 extends the duty to women), § 5: 'the country' in the Act means the Kingdom of Denmark except the Faroe Islands and Greenland; § 13: conscripts resident or staying in the country must attend Forsvarets Dag in the year they turn eighteen; § 1 stk. 3: someone who moves to Denmark from the Faroes or Greenland after living there at least ten years may be exempted. So a person living in Greenland isn't called (my reading of §§ 5 and 13 together): none.

sources.title: Retsinformation: Bekendtgørelse af værnepligtsloven (LBK nr 225 af 13/03/2006, as amended to LOV nr 715 af 20/06/2025)
sources.said: Den, der er tilflyttet fra Færøerne eller Grønland efter at have haft ophold der i mindst 10 år, kan af forsvarsministeren eller den myndighed, forsvarsministeren bemyndiger til det, fritages for værnepligt. ... Ved udtrykket »landet« forstås i denne lov Kongeriget Danmark med undtagelse af Færøerne og Grønland. ... Værnepligtige, der har bopæl eller ophold her i landet, skal møde til Forsvarets Dag i det år, hvori de fylder 18 år.

sources.title: Naalakkersuisut (Government of Greenland): answer to Inatsisartut § 37 question no. 27-2025 on child labour, 21 May 2025
sources.said: Børn under 13 år må ikke beskæftiges ved arbejde. Efter ansøgning kan politiet tillade, at børn under 13 år deltager eller medvirker i kulturelle og ... Unge, som er fyldt 13 år, og som er omfattet af undervisningspligten må kun beskæftiges med de former for lettere arbejde, der fremgår af bilag 7 og 8 til bekendtgørelse om unges arbejde i Grønland. ... 15-17-årige, der ikke er undervisningspligtig må beskæftiges ved arbejde
